🚀 AWS Certification Roadmap for Beginners | Cloud Roles Explained

Confused about which AWS certification to choose?

In this beginner-friendly AWS certification roadmap, you'll learn how AWS certifications align with different cloud career paths, including Cloud Engineer, Cloud Developer, Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, Data Engineer, Security Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, and AI Engineer roles.

Whether you're just starting your cloud journey or planning your next certification, this video will help you choose the right AWS certification based on your career goals.

videos.description:
🚀 From Beginner to AWS Certified in 3 Weeks | Cloud Practitioner Journey

Thinking about starting your AWS certification journey?

In this video, I'll share how I prepared for and passed the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam in just 3 weeks. I'll walk you through my study plan, learning resources, practice exams, and tips that helped me understand cloud concepts and successfully clear the certification.

If you're a beginner with little or no cloud experience, this roadmap can help you prepare efficiently and avoid common mistakes.
